title: gvrd冠军网格01
instruction:
您是 Alba Reinholt，Grindleford Valley 休闲区的赛事运营策划者，州 12U 锦标赛现在由您负责。 Dunmarrow Logistics 和 Blackmarsh Fisheries 为该活动提供支持，但电网必须为该地区自己的六个场地运营服务。 44 团队锦标赛从 2 月 7 星期五到 2 月 9 星期日举行，Carsten Alcantara 需要在 2 月 3 比赛结束时发布可发布的比赛和裁判名单。使用`championship_source.xlsx`中完整的比赛、场地、裁判信息；它包括分组关系、团队路径、场地特征、可用时间窗口和队员等级。不要发明比赛、球队、场地或裁判。在您启动的工作目录的顶层创建`tournament_grid.xlsx`，并使用该文件名。这将交给 Dmitri Sepulveda 进行发布，并交给 Olamide Tikhonov 进行裁判部署，因此需要一个清晰的每日日历/网格视图和一个支持性分配或验证视图，让他们在不打开源文件的情况下检查每场比赛和工作人员。
编号要求：1) 将每场列出的比赛在六个指定场地之一和一个列出的时间段中准确放置一次，并为其分配准确的一名可用裁判组； 2) 同一支球队的任意两次出场之间至少保持90分钟，包括通过括号连接的出场，并确保后一轮比赛在其必备比赛结束之前无法开始； 3) 仅使用半决赛和决赛的两个全尺寸场地，并观察源中特定场地的可用性和维护关闭； 4) 仅将两个点亮的字段用于源中标识的晚间时段，将所有其他字段保留在其日光窗口内； 5) 各草地场地保持在每日比赛限额内，不超过每日场地和同时比赛容量； 6) 仅当其列出的等级符合该场比赛的资格时才分配队员，并且不要将队员安排在连续比赛或重叠比赛中； 7) 尊重周日教堂停车协议，在12:30之前不开始周日比赛，同时仍在规定的周日操作窗口内完成决赛； 8) 通过在每个预定参赛项目中显示日期、开始和结束时间、场地、阶段、比赛标识符、球队或分组位置以及裁判人员，使日历易于浏览； 9）包括一个简明的验证视图，可识别预定比赛和人员的数量、每日和现场总计
ls、点亮/全尺寸使用以及任何硬规则例外，在已完成的计划中例外为零。如果括号位置尚未指定球队，请保留来源的括号标签而不是猜测获胜者。保持工作簿适合广大公众：使用简单标签、一致的时间符号、冻结或重复有用的标题，并确保没有条目隐藏在截断、过滤或溢出指示器后面。不要添加解释性文字来代替完整的网格，不要更改来源的比赛标识符或工作人员姓名，也不要使用互联网数据。仅将请求的工作簿保存在工作目录顶层。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/championship_source.xlsx` — 权威赛事输入，包含完整的 44 球队分组和比赛关系、六个场地及其特点和封闭、可用位置以及裁判组的评分和可用性。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `tournament_grid.xlsx` — 完整的三天锦标赛比赛和裁判分配网格，具有面向公众的日历和支持验证/分配信息。 （准确地使用tournament_grid.xlsx在起始工作目录的顶层写入。；每个源比赛必须出现一次，并具有一个有效的字段、时间段和裁判人员。；必须满足所有硬调度、场地、括号休息、周日、容量和裁判资格规则。；日历条目必须保持可见和可读，没有溢出或隐藏行。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
materials.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Tournament Notes
rows: 15 minutes; a field cannot host consecutive source slots without this turnover
90 minutes after a match ends before its winner may start again
No match may start before 12:30; all play closes at 18:30
17:30 is an evening slot and is restricted to lit fields
Maximum 6 matches in daytime slots; maximum 2 matches in the evening slot
Semifinal and Final: full-size fields only
Grade 3 qualifies for Grades 1-3; Grade 2 qualifies for Grades 1-2; Grade 1 qualifies for Grade 1
Scoreboard cart is held behind North Stadium after 16:00.

sheets.name: Match List
rows: Bracket positions remain labels until results are known.

sheets.name: Fields
rows: Closures include setup and recovery time.

sheets.name: Slot Calendar
rows: Slots are fixed 75-minute match intervals with a 15-minute turnover buffer.

sheets.name: Referee Crews
rows: A crew requires one source slot between assignments.

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Public Calendar
rows: State 12U Championship | Match and Referee Grid

sheets.name: Assignment List
rows: Complete deployment list; sorted by date and start time.

sheets.name: Validation
rows: Operational check summary for publication and referee deployment

criteria.description: 每个源匹配项在提交的作业中仅出现一次。
criteria.evidence: 作业和日历视图与源匹配 ID 的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 解析所有计划的匹配 ID 并验证集合相等性和计数相等性。

original.criterion: Every source match appears exactly once in the submitted assignment.
original.evidence: Assignment and calendar views compared with source match IDs.
original.grader_hint: Parse all scheduled match IDs and verify set equality and count equality.

criteria.description: 每个预定条目都具有一个有效的源字段和源时隙。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源可用性验证字段/时间对。

original.criterion: Every scheduled entry has exactly one valid source field and source time slot.
original.grader_hint: Validate field/time pairs against source availability.

criteria.description: 每场比赛只有一名裁判员。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝条目的空白和重复的人员分配。

original.criterion: Every match has exactly one referee crew.
original.grader_hint: Reject blanks and duplicate crew assignments for an entry.

criteria.description: 场地上没有两场比赛重叠。
criteria.grader_hint: 按字段比较间隔。

original.criterion: No two matches overlap on a field.
original.grader_hint: Compare intervals by field.

criteria.description: 没有一支球队或队伍的出场间隔时间少于 90 分钟。
criteria.evidence: 匹配时间和源括号路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估直接的团队冲突和所有可行的前任/继任路径。

original.criterion: No team or bracket lineage has less than 90 minutes between appearances.
original.evidence: Match times and source bracket paths.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate direct team conflicts and all feasible predecessor/successor paths.

criteria.description: 每个先决条件匹配都会在其相关匹配开始之前完成。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个定向支架边缘。

original.criterion: Every prerequisite match finishes before its dependent match begins.
original.grader_hint: Check every directed bracket edge.

criteria.description: 半决赛仅在全尺寸场地进行。
criteria.grader_hint: 将阶段标签与源全尺寸字段集进行比较。

original.criterion: Semifinals are on full-size fields only.
original.grader_hint: Compare stage labels with source full-size field set.

criteria.description: 决赛仅在全尺寸场地进行。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源字段特征进行验证。

original.criterion: The final is on a full-size field only.
original.grader_hint: Validate against source field characteristics.

criteria.description: 没有预定的比赛属于封闭赛场。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查间隔交叉点，而不仅仅是开始时间。

original.criterion: No scheduled match falls in a field closure.
original.grader_hint: Check interval intersection, not just start time.

criteria.description: 在其日光窗之外不使用非照明场。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证每个字段的操作间隔。

original.criterion: No non-lit field is used outside its daylight window.
original.grader_hint: Validate each field's operating interval.

criteria.description: 每个夜间照明场地条目都位于两个照明场地之一。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源晚间时段中的所有条目。

original.criterion: Each lit-field evening entry is on one of the two lit fields.
original.grader_hint: Check all entries in source evening slots.

criteria.description: 每个草地都保持在或低于其源每日比赛上限。
criteria.grader_hint: 按日期和草地计数比赛。

original.criterion: Every grass field remains at or below its source daily match cap.
original.grader_hint: Count matches by date and grass field.

criteria.description: 每日同时比赛不超过源运行能力。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算每个时隙的并发间隔。

original.criterion: Daily simultaneous matches do not exceed source operational capacity.
original.grader_hint: Count concurrent intervals for each slot.

criteria.description: 周日没有在12:30之前开始的比赛。
criteria.grader_hint: 将周日开始与12:30 进行比较。

original.criterion: Sunday has no match beginning before 12:30.
original.grader_hint: Compare Sunday starts to 12:30.

criteria.description: 决赛在源周日运行窗口内结束。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查周日收盘时的最终结果。

original.criterion: The final ends within the source Sunday operating window.
original.grader_hint: Check final end against Sunday close.

criteria.description: 每个指定的工作人员都可以在整个比赛间歇期间随时待命。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查间隔遏制。

original.criterion: Every assigned crew is available for the entire match interval.
original.grader_hint: Check interval containment.

criteria.description: 没有人员被分配到重叠的比赛中。
criteria.grader_hint: 检测每个人员的任何间隔重叠。

original.criterion: No crew is assigned to overlapping matches.
original.grader_hint: Detect any interval overlap per crew.

criteria.description: 没有人员被分配到连续的源槽位。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个日期的相邻时段以及跨时段边界。

original.criterion: No crew is assigned to consecutive source slots.
original.grader_hint: Check adjacent slots on each date and across slot boundaries.

criteria.description: 每个队员的等级均符合其指定比赛所要求的等级。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源等级排序和匹配要求。

original.criterion: Each crew's grade meets the grade required by its assigned match.
original.grader_hint: Use the source grade ordering and match requirements.

criteria.description: 在其源服务日期之外不会分配任何机组人员。
criteria.grader_hint: 将分配日期与可用性进行比较。

original.criterion: No crew is assigned outside its source service dates.
original.grader_hint: Compare assignment date with availability.

criteria.description: 当源网格容量需要时，所有六个源字段都被表示，没有发明字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查词汇和所需的操作用途。

original.criterion: All six source fields are represented when required by the source grid capacity, with no invented field.
original.evidence: Field values and source field list.
original.grader_hint: Check vocabulary and required operational use.

criteria.description: 每日预定比赛总数等于当天显示的条目总数。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立于分配行重新计算。

original.criterion: Daily scheduled-match totals equal the sum of entries shown for that day.
original.grader_hint: Recompute independently from assignment rows.

criteria.description: 每日字段总计等于基础分配行。
criteria.grader_hint: 按日期和字段重新计算。

original.criterion: Daily field totals equal the underlying assignment rows.
original.grader_hint: Recompute by date and field.

criteria.description: 报告的异常计数为零，并且没有列出硬规则异常。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新运行所有硬检查并与规定的结果进行比较。

original.criterion: The reported exception count is zero and no hard-rule exception is listed.
original.grader_hint: Re-run all hard checks and compare with stated result.

criteria.description: 报告的照明场使用情况与预定的晚间条目一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 从行重新计算照明使用情况。

original.criterion: Reported lit-field usage agrees with scheduled evening entries.
original.grader_hint: Recompute lit usage from rows.

criteria.description: 报告的半决赛和决赛的全尺寸场地使用情况与时间表一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 分阶段重新计算。

original.criterion: Reported full-size-field usage for semifinal and final entries agrees with the schedule.
original.grader_hint: Recompute by stage.

criteria.description: 所有计划阶段标签都是源阶段标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查词汇相等性。

original.criterion: All scheduled stage labels are source stage labels.
original.grader_hint: Check vocabulary equality.

criteria.description: 所有预定的球队或括号位置标签均从源中保留。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝猜测或更改的参与者标签。

original.criterion: All scheduled team or bracket-position labels are preserved from the source.
original.grader_hint: Reject guessed or altered participant labels.

criteria.description: 每个日历条目都包括比赛 ID、日期、开始、结束、场地、阶段、参与者标签和工作人员。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个条目是否有非空白必填字段。

original.criterion: Every calendar entry includes match ID, date, start, end, field, stage, participant labels, and crew.
original.grader_hint: Inspect each entry for nonblank required fields.

criteria.description: 日历显示所有条目，没有折叠的溢出指示器或隐藏条目。
criteria.grader_hint: 每天检查并以正常变焦进行现场观察。

original.criterion: The calendar exposes all entries without collapsed overflow indicators or hidden entries.
original.grader_hint: Inspect every day and field view at normal zoom.

criteria.description: 日历标题和标签可读，无需剪裁列。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看默认打开视图和打印/页面预览（如果可用）。

original.criterion: Calendar headings and labels are readable without clipped columns.
original.grader_hint: Review at default opening view and printed/page preview if available.

criteria.description: 工作簿成功打开，并包含重新计算或内部一致的公式或计算验证值。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公库打开并将计算单元格与行进行比较。

original.criterion: The workbook opens successfully and contains formulas or computed validation values that recalculate or are internally consistent.
original.grader_hint: Open with a standard office library and compare computed cells with rows.

criteria.description: 没有分配使用错误日期的源时间段。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证日期时段成员资格。

original.criterion: No assignment uses a source time slot on a wrong date.
original.grader_hint: Validate date-slot membership.

criteria.description: 没有匹配项分配给源排除在其阶段的字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估每个阶段的限制。

original.criterion: No match is assigned to a field excluded for its stage by the source.
original.grader_hint: Evaluate every stage restriction.

criteria.description: 每场比赛的结束时间都比开始时间晚源比赛持续时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的持续时间关系。

original.criterion: Every match end time is later than its start time by the source match duration.
original.grader_hint: Check exact duration relation.

criteria.description: 统计所有赛段（包括淘汰赛）后，每日草帽均未超出。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要在计数中省略括号阶段。

original.criterion: No daily grass cap is exceeded after counting all stages, including knockout matches.
original.grader_hint: Do not omit bracket stages from counts.

criteria.description: 没有字段有两个条目以违反源周转规则的方式共享端点。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源应用端点约定。

original.criterion: No field has two entries sharing an endpoint in a way that violates the source turnover rule.
original.grader_hint: Apply endpoint convention from source.

criteria.description: 没有球队出现在两场同时进行的比赛中。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有直接和继承的参与者冲突。

original.criterion: No team appears in two simultaneous matches.
original.grader_hint: Check all direct and inherited participant conflicts.

criteria.description: 赛程表准确包含源比赛总数。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较不同的 ID 和计数。

original.criterion: The schedule contains exactly the source total number of matches.
original.grader_hint: Compare distinct IDs and count.

criteria.description: 该明细表准确包含了分配中使用的合格机组人员的源总数，或者清楚地报告了未使用的机组人员但未分配他们。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证没有幻影人员并核对已使用/未使用的计数。

original.criterion: The schedule contains exactly the source total number of eligible crews used in assignments or clearly reports unused crews without assigning them.
original.grader_hint: Verify no phantom crew and reconcile used/unused counts.

criteria.description: 半决赛或决赛不会使用来源不可用的人员。
criteria.evidence: 船员可用性和淘汰赛行。
criteria.grader_hint: 单独检查特殊阶段的作业。

original.criterion: No source-unavailable crew is used for a semifinal or final.
original.grader_hint: Check special-stage assignments separately.

criteria.description: 每场特级比赛都有符合其特级要求的队员。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有符合非默认成绩要求的匹配项。

original.criterion: Every special-grade match has a crew meeting its special-grade requirement.
original.grader_hint: Check all matches with nondefault grade requirements.

criteria.description: 验证视图标识所有使用的预定日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 将设置的日期与作业进行比较。

original.criterion: The validation view identifies all scheduled dates used.
original.grader_hint: Compare date set with assignment.

criteria.description: 验证视图标识所有使用的字段及其计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较字段集和计数。

original.criterion: The validation view identifies all fields used and their counts.
original.grader_hint: Compare field set and counts.

criteria.description: 验证视图可识别所有使用的人员及其分配计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算船员人数。

original.criterion: The validation view identifies all crews used and their assignment counts.
original.grader_hint: Recompute crew counts.

criteria.description: 工作簿使用源匹配标识符而不重命名它们。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查代表和所有身份证件。

original.criterion: The workbook uses the source match identifiers without renaming them.
original.grader_hint: Check representative and all IDs.

criteria.description: 该工作簿将验证结果标记为零异常或等效的简单语言状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要明确的零异常状态。

original.criterion: The workbook labels the validation result as zero exceptions or equivalent plain-language status.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit zero-exception status.

criteria.description: 提交的文件是 .xlsx 工作簿，而不是重命名的不同格式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 ZIP/OOXML 签名。

original.criterion: The submitted file is an .xlsx workbook rather than a renamed different format.
original.grader_hint: Inspect ZIP/OOXML signature.

criteria.description: 面向公众的日历具有稳定的可见日期/时间顺序。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每天内的时间顺序。

original.criterion: The public-facing calendar has a stable visible date/time ordering.
original.grader_hint: Check chronological ordering within each day.

criteria.description: 主网格中的场地名称和工作人员名称不会在视觉上被截断。
criteria.grader_hint: 在正常视图下检查最长的标签。

original.criterion: Field names and crew names are not visually truncated in the primary grid.
original.grader_hint: Inspect longest labels at normal view.

criteria.description: 非专业出版商可以立即使用该工作簿，而无需依赖源工作簿来解码基本计划字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断清晰度、导航性以及日历和验证视图是否支持发布和部署。

original.criterion: The workbook is immediately usable by a non-specialist publisher without relying on the source workbook to decode basic schedule fields.
original.grader_hint: Judge clarity, navigability, and whether the calendar and validation view support publication and deployment.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿清楚地区分了普通比赛、半决赛和决赛，但没有暗示未经证实的事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断视觉层次并忠实使用源标签。

original.criterion: The presentation distinguishes ordinary, semifinal, and final matches clearly without implying unsupported facts.
original.grader_hint: Judge visual hierarchy and faithful use of source labels.

criteria.description: 决赛定于周日举行。
criteria.grader_hint: 将最终日期与锦标赛范围进行比较。

original.criterion: The final is scheduled on Sunday.
original.grader_hint: Compare final date with tournament horizon.

criteria.description: 所有三个锦标赛日期都已安排了源需要比赛的条目。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查约会范围，没有未经授权的第四次约会。

original.criterion: All three tournament dates have scheduled entries where the source requires play.
original.grader_hint: Check date coverage and no unauthorized fourth date.

criteria.description: 三天比赛期间内没有任何预定参赛项目。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证每个日期。

original.criterion: No scheduled entry is outside the three-day tournament horizon.
original.grader_hint: Validate every date.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录

spec.professional_context: This is an operational scheduling deliverable for a first-time, multi-field youth championship. The workbook must be usable by a coordinator publishing the grid and a referee coordinator deploying crews.
difficulty_sources: Interlocking bracket precedence and 90-minute team-rest constraints across later rounds
Scarce lit and full-size field windows combined with a binding grass-field daily cap
Limited referee qualifications and a no-consecutive-match rule
Need to reconcile a solver-produced assignment with a readable public calendar and validation view

authoring_plan.source_file: Build championship_source.xlsx as the sole supplied reference. Include a fixed 44-team single-elimination bracket with 43 matches: preliminary, round-of-32, round-of-16, quarterfinal, semifinal, and final records. Use stable synthetic team names and bracket-position labels, with predecessor links for knockout matches. Include six named fields, exactly two full-size fields, exactly two lit fields, field operating windows, maintenance closures, the Sunday 12:30 start restriction, match duration and turnover information, and the grass-field daily cap. Include a finite pool of synthetic referee crews with availability dates, grade levels, and at least two scarce high-grade crews. Include a source slot calendar for Friday 7 February, Saturday 8 February, and Sunday 9 February. Do not use real identifiers or addresses.

constraints.assignment: Each of 43 matches is assigned exactly once to one source date-slot-field combination and one crew.
constraints.precedence: Every bracket predecessor ends before its dependent match starts; dependent matches also need the 90-minute team rest buffer where a lineage can continue.
constraints.rest: For any team or possible bracket lineage, appearances must be separated by at least 90 minutes from the earlier match end/start relation defined in the source.
constraints.fields: Semifinals and final use only full-size fields; closures and operating windows are hard exclusions; evening slots use only the two lit fields.
constraints.capacity: Each grass field has a daily cap of five matches; source simultaneous-match and field capacities must be respected. Make Friday/Saturday grass capacity and the scarce evening/full-size windows materially binding.
constraints.referees: Crew availability must contain the full match interval, grade must meet match requirement, overlapping assignments are forbidden, and consecutive source slots are forbidden. Make the highest grade qualification scarce for semifinals/final.
constraints.calendar: Sunday has no match before 12:30 and the final must finish within the source Sunday close.

authoring_plan.tightness: Target approximately 0.72 feasible-set tightness. Ensure a naive earliest-slot greedy assignment encounters a blocked field, rest, or scarce-grade decision and needs backtracking or deliberate balancing, while retaining multiple feasible schedules.
authoring_plan.gold: Run an offline constraint solver over the generated source instance, retain one feasible schedule, and emit the checker from the predicates above rather than hard-coded cell answers. Independently verify all 43 IDs, precedence paths, 90-minute rest relations, field closures, grass caps, lit/full-size restrictions, Sunday window, crew availability/qualification, non-overlap, and no-consecutive-slot rules. Render and inspect the workbook; confirm every calendar entry is visible and the validation totals reconcile. The reference solution passed all rubric items.

deliverables.description: A complete three-day tournament match and referee assignment grid with a public-facing calendar and supporting validation/assignment information.
constraints: Write at the top level of the starting working directory using exactly tournament_grid.xlsx.
Every source match must appear exactly once with one valid field, time slot, and referee crew.
All hard scheduling, field, bracket-rest, Sunday, capacity, and referee qualification rules must be satisfied.
Calendar entries must remain visible and readable without overflow or hidden rows.

original_instruction:
You are Alba Reinholt, the tournament operations planner for Grindleford Valley Recreation District, and the state 12U championships are now your responsibility. Dunmarrow Logistics and Blackmarsh Fisheries are supporting the event, but the grid must work for the district's own six-field operation. The 44-team tournament runs from Friday 7 February through Sunday 9 February, and Carsten Alcantara needs a publishable match-and-referee grid by 3 February when the brackets close. Use the complete match, field, and referee information in `championship_source.xlsx`; it includes the bracket relationships, team paths, field characteristics, available time windows, and crew grades. Do not invent matches, teams, fields, or referees. Create `tournament_grid.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly that filename. This will be handed to Dmitri Sepulveda for publication and to Olamide Tikhonov for referee deployment, so it needs a clear day-by-day calendar/grid view and a supporting assignment or validation view that lets them check every match and crew without opening the source file. Numbered requirements: 1) place every listed match exactly once on one of the six named fields and one listed time slot, and assign exactly one available referee crew to it; 2) keep at least 90 minutes between any two appearances by the same team, including appearances connected through the bracket, and ensure a later-round match cannot begin before its prerequisite match has finished; 3) use only the two full-size fields for semifinals and the final, and observe the field-specific availability and maintenance closures in the source; 4) use the two lit fields only for the evening slots identified in the source, leaving every other field within its daylight window; 5) keep each grass field within its daily match limit and do not exceed the daily field and simultaneous-match capacities; 6) assign crews only when their listed grade qualifies them for that match, and do not put a crew on consecutive matches or overlapping matches; 7) respect the Sunday church-parking agreement by starting no Sunday match before 12:30, while still completing the final within the stated Sunday operating window; 8) make the calendar easy to scan by showing day, start and end time, field, stage, match identifier, teams or bracket positions, and referee crew in every scheduled entry; 9) include a concise validation view that identifies the counts of scheduled matches and crews, the daily and field totals, the lit/full-size usage, and any hard-rule exceptions, with zero exceptions in the completed plan. If a bracket position is not yet a named team, retain the source's bracket label rather than guessing a winner. Keep the workbook suitable for a broad public audience: use plain labels, consistent time notation, freeze or repeat useful headings, and make sure no entry is hidden behind truncation, filtering, or an overflow indicator. Do not add explanatory prose in place of a complete grid, do not change the source's match identifiers or crew names, and do not use internet data. Save only the requested workbook at the working-directory top level.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/championship_source.xlsx` — Authoritative tournament input containing the complete 44-team bracket and match relationships, six fields and their characteristics and closures, available slots, and referee crews with grades and availability.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `tournament_grid.xlsx` — A complete three-day tournament match and referee assignment grid with a public-facing calendar and supporting validation/assignment information. (Write at the top level of the starting working directory using exactly tournament_grid.xlsx.; Every source match must appear exactly once with one valid field, time slot, and referee crew.; All hard scheduling, field, bracket-rest, Sunday, capacity, and referee qualification rules must be satisfied.; Calendar entries must remain visible and readable without overflow or hidden rows.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
